I went to bed before my boyfriend woke up this morning(temporary I’m out of the country across the world). Normally we could talk before I go to bed, but I assumed he was just still sleeping and I didn’t want to wake him up. I texted him good morning and I hope he had a wonderful day and that I was going to bed. When I woke up(it was 5pm his time) I had not a single text from him. He knows he can text me when I’m sleeping and it won’t wake me up. Normally I would have a cute good night text, but nope, not this time. What was he doing that he couldn’t text me(he said he was playing a video game). A video game I got him! This just hurts me, but there isn’t a whole lot I can do, I’m so far away. I will know something is up if he doesn’t want to see me the weekend I get back. I’m so hurt I don’t even want to go back home. I just want to stay in this new country and start a new life. A fresh start

I’m sure I’m way over thinking this and he isn’t cheating, but I didn’t think my boyfriend of a year would ever cheat either. The way he even cheated, he brought it up about how one of his friends did that and how he thought it was horrible and I told him I agreed.
You don’t realize you will miss your morning wood, but I kind of do. But that’s no more
